messages:
jamie (Customer): Hey, hitting a 413 on /v1/rerank. Error payload says token_count=98,762 max_total_tokens=65,536. Happening consistently for one customer workspace. trace_id=tr_123abc

lina (Support): Thanks for the report — can you paste the minimal repro (query + one offending doc) or a curl? Also which model/endpoint and SDK/header info?

jamie (Customer): Repro below (sanitized). We call rerank with query ~2k chars and ~120 docs, many full-text passages. Example curl: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_***' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-re-rank-v1","query":"<very long query here>","docs":[{"id":"d1","text":"<very long doc text>"}, ...]}'
```

lina (Support): Copying logs now. @rerank-bot can you surface the request size + token histogram for tr_123abc?

rerank-bot: request_id=tr_123abc size_bytes=1,234,567 token_estimate=98762 docs_count=120 max_doc_tokens=2300

chris (ML Eng): From the runtime logs: request exceeded configured rerank budget. We currently enforce: max_query_tokens=4096, max_per_doc_tokens=4096, max_total_tokens=65536. In this request total token estimate ~= 98k so we cut.

jamie (Customer): Ok — the error message just returned 413 with no guidance. Customer expects actionable tips (which fields to trim, whether to split docs). They're confused and think it's an auth/billing error.

lina (Support): Understood. Two immediate options to unblock: 1) Snippet docs to passages (limit each doc to top N sentences) 2) Use vector search to pre-filter candidates to <50 docs then rerank. Also can send code to compute token counts locally.

chris (ML Eng): Quick token-check snippet we gave them:

```python
# use tiktoken-like estimate
import math
def est_tokens(text):
    return math.ceil(len(text) / 4)

query_tokens = est_tokens(query)
doc_tokens = sum(est_tokens(d['text']) for d in docs)
print(query_tokens, doc_tokens, query_tokens + doc_tokens)
```

aria (Docs): We should update the rerank error copy. Suggestion: 4xx body with code `rerank_input_too_large` and fields: `max_total_tokens`, `max_query_tokens`, `max_per_doc_tokens`, and a short `help_url`. Example user-facing message: 

"Request rejected: total token estimate 98,762 exceeds rerank limit 65,536. Reduce docs or send shorter passages. See https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits for chunking examples"

lina (Support): +1 — also propose providing per-field token breakdown in the error (e.g., query=3,800; docs_total=94,962; top_doc=2,300) so it's clear what to trim. Customer would love an inline hint.

chris (ML Eng): Agree. For infra: we can add a small change to return a structured JSON body rather than a plain 413. That avoids UX confusion with billing. We'll need a short release window to avoid breaking existing parsers; include `error.code` and `error.hints`.

jamie (Customer): That would help a lot. In the short term can you confirm a recommended per-request doc_count limit for rerank? 50 docs per request is a safe heuristic?

chris (ML Eng): Heuristic: aim for docs_count * avg_doc_tokens + query_tokens < 40k for comfortable headroom. If avg_doc_tokens unknown, try 50 docs of ~500 tokens. If customers need full-document ranking, prefer chunking and rank on passages or use our batch rerank (we can help design).

aria (Docs): Action items: 1) Docs update with explicit limits + quick snippet for token estimation and chunking patterns. 2) KB page with sample curl + chunking script. 3) Propose example error JSON and wording. I'll draft by EOB. @lina can you paste the exact error response body sent to the customer?

lina (Support): The response body was minimal: `{\"error\":\"request_too_large\",\"status\":413}` — no token counts. Customer pasted that and we got escalated.

chris (ML Eng): I'll open a small infra PR to include token hints in error and add `error.code=rerank_input_too_large`. Will include opt-in header `Accept-Rerank-Hints: true` for backward compatibility.

lina (Support): Thanks everyone. Jamie, temporary workaround we recommended to customer: pre-filter to top 40 candidates with their existing vector index, then call rerank on those. Also trim the query to the core question. They confirmed it works.

jamie (Customer): Confirmed workaround worked, thanks. Please keep me posted on the error message change so I can update the customer's docs.

aria (Docs): Will follow up with PR link and proposed copy. I'll include example error JSON: 

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rerank_input_too_large",
    "message": "Total token estimate 98762 exceeds limit 65536",
    "hints": {
      "query_tokens": "3800",
      "docs_total_tokens": "94962",
      "max_total_tokens": "65536",
      "help_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits"
    }
  }
}
```

chris (ML Eng): FYI internal note — we should also log per-request token_estimate in the request audit and make it available in the error when possible. That will cut down on escalations.

lina (Support): Marking this thread as resolved for the customer workaround, leaving open until docs/infra PRs land. :white_check_mark:

jamie (Customer): Thanks team, appreciate the quick triage.

rerank-bot: escalation_label=needs-docs; owner=aria; infra_ticket=INF-7891
